verdict.rationale:
Stripe documents holding a stablecoin balance in a Financial Account (Treasury, public preview) alongside fiat balances, and stablecoin payouts/conversion for Connect platforms, suggesting some fiat↔stablecoin movement exists, but there is no explicit end-to-end documentation of an internal-transfer or rebalancing API/dashboard flow for a finance lead to move value between fiat and stablecoin balances. Community commentary even shows confusion about how stablecoin balances interact with fiat payouts (stripe-crypto-comm-7), and features like stablecoin Treasury and card issuing are still in preview.

missing for 10: explicit API/dashboard docs for moving funds between fiat and stablecoin balances, dedicated rebalancing endpoints, and independent confirmation this works in production (not just preview).
